hints.title: Reading the IMU heading
hints.content: `imu.getRobotYawPitchRollAngles()` returns a `YawPitchRollAngles` object. Call `.getYaw(AngleUnit.DEGREES)` on it to get a double in degrees.

hints.title: Turning direction
hints.content: To turn right (clockwise), left motor spins forward and right motor spins backward. Set `leftMotor.setPower(correction)` and `rightMotor.setPower(-correction)`. If the error is positive, correction is positive, and the robot turns right.

hints.title: Breaking out of the loop
hints.content: Use `if (Math.abs(error) < THRESHOLD) break;` inside the while loop. This exits as soon as you're within 2 degrees of the target.
